notes: Sword light 1 (move sword-light-1, 4 active ticks): a descending diagonal slash from upper right to lower left about the chest pivot (0, 1.5, 0), yaw +55° → −55°. The first three keys are the original arc (blade from 25° raised to level, about chest height), so it hits standing targets exactly as before; then it dives to 45° and 52° lowered over the last two active ticks, passing about 0.4 m above the ground at 1.2 m range, so a 0.9 m creature such as the fixture hound (mw-e04.38) is hit too, with no auto-aim. Matches the clip anim-knight-sword-light-1. Key 0 is the pose before the first active tick.
